map.精密轴承寿命（本页代码口径，ISO 281 球轴承指数 p=3）：L₁₀=(C÷: Precision bearing life (as implemented here; ISO 281 ball bearing exponent p = 3): L10 = (C/P)^3 x 1e6 (revolutions; C dynamic load rating in kN, P equivalent dynamic load in kN); L10(h) = L10 / (60 x n) (n in rpm). Relative factors: accuracy factor (p0/p6/p5/p4/p2 -> 1.0/1.05/1.1/1.2/1.5) and lubrication factor (grease/oil/oil mist/jet -> 0.8/1.0/1.3/1.5) are heuristic coefficients on this page, offered only as a relative comparison; no reliable model converts them into a quantitative accuracy-retention life, and this page does not output such a life figure or grade. Linked values: load ratio = P/C x 100 (%), dn value = n x d (d is the entered bearing bore in mm). Validation: C, P, n and d must be >0, otherwise a prompt for valid positive numbers is shown and the calculation stops. Notes: load ratio >20 suggests a larger size, dn >500000 is this page's high-speed lubrication guide line, otherwise conditions are good.
map.基于 ISO 281 的 L10 额定寿命公式计算疲劳寿命；精度等级因子（P0–: Fatigue life uses the ISO 281 L10 rated-life formula. Accuracy-grade factors (P0-P2) and lubrication factors are heuristic coefficients for relative comparison on this page (not an ISO 281 accuracy-life prediction and not manufacturer-certified data); they are only multiplied for relative comparison, with no quantitative accuracy-retention life inferred and no grade derived. The dn value uses the entered bearing bore.
map.ISO 281 仅定义 L10 疲劳寿命；精度/润滑因子本页仅作相对比较的启发式: ISO 281 defines only L10 fatigue life; accuracy/lubrication factors are heuristic coefficients for relative comparison only on this page, with no verifiable model to convert them into a quantitative accuracy-retention life, so this page outputs neither that life figure nor a grade; actual accuracy retention also depends on contamination and mounting.
map.算法：球轴承取 p=3，L10 转数 = (C/P)³×1e6；L10 小时 =: Method: ball bearing p = 3; L10 revolutions = (C/P)^3 x 1e6; L10 hours = revolutions / (60 x speed) (the above follow the ISO 281 fatigue-life definition). Relative factors: accuracy factor (P0 1.0, P6 1.05, P5 1.1, P4 1.2, P2 1.5) and lubrication factor (grease 0.8, oil bath 1.0, oil mist 1.3, jet 1.5) are heuristic coefficients on this page, multiplied only for relative comparison; no reliable model converts them into a quantitative accuracy-retention life, and this page outputs neither that figure nor a grade. Load ratio = P/C x 100%; dn value = speed x bearing bore d (mm); load ratio >20% suggests a larger size, dn value >500000 indicates a high-speed lubrication note.
map.例：P4 精密级、脂润滑、C=20kN、P=3kN、5000rpm、内径 d=2: Example: P4 precision grade, grease, C=20 kN, P=3 kN, 5000 rpm, bore d=25 mm gives L10 revolutions 2.963e8, L10 life 987.7 h, relative factor 1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96 (relative comparison only, not a life), load ratio 15%, dn value 125000; the load ratio suggests checking the size. With P2 grade, oil bath, C=30 kN, P=2 kN, 3000 rpm, bore d=25 mm: L10 life 18750 h, relative factor 1.5 x 1.0 = 1.50 (relative comparison only), load ratio 6.7%, dn value 75000. The relative factors indicate only relative difference, not a quantitative multiple of accuracy-retention life.
map.因为缺乏可核验的模型。ISO 281 只给出 L10 疲劳额定寿命，并不提供「精: Because a verifiable model is lacking. ISO 281 defines only the L10 fatigue rating life and provides no model for accuracy-retention life; the accuracy-grade factors (P0-P2: 1.0-1.5) and lubrication factors (grease/oil/mist/jet: 0.8-1.5) here are heuristic coefficients for relative comparison, not ISO 281 accuracy-life corrections and not manufacturer-certified data. Multiplying them by L10 yields an hour figure with no reliable basis, so this page stops outputting that life figure, years and grade, retaining only the relative comparison of factors (e.g. P2 1.5 x jet 1.5 = 2.25 means a higher relative factor, not a life multiplier). Accuracy retention also depends on contamination, mounting and load spectrum; consult the bearing manufacturer's manual and measurements for final selection.
